author: MiniMax M3.1 Flash (builder, wave 1)
reason: Tripo browser control and the Customuse MCP are not exposed in this Claude Code CLI (verified by tool search). These requests are for the manager to execute through the connected browser/MCP surfaces. No spending beyond existing Tripo credits is assumed; Meshy is excluded.

conventions.export: glTF 2.0 (.glb), separate materials, no baked lighting, real-world scale
conventions.licence: original generation only; record provider, date and terms before publishing
conventions.art_direction: docs/concepts/singapore-on-foot.png, singapore-driving.png, singapore-helicopter.png (primary targets); docs/visual-references.json (secondary evidence)

requests.prompt: Original compact sedan for a Singapore street game, 1990s-2000s Asian city taxi-inspired civilian three-box saloon. Right-hand-drive cabin, four visible wheels with separate tyre and hub, modelled front and rear bumpers, headlights, tail lights, wing mirrors, door shut lines, tinted glass, subtle road dust. Paint: desaturated pearl grey with light wear, not a branded livery.

requests.delivered_note: Customuse job completed and integrated: cleaned in Blender (4.4 m, ground at Y=0, nose -Z) with separated spinning wheels; in engine as the sedan and the police body

status_summary: All 18 requests were delivered during wave 1 and integrated into the build: 8 Customuse hero models and 10 Tripo props (the hawker counter came through the Tripo small-prop route). Every raw source is reproducible with game/tools/fetch_provider_assets.sh and is rebuilt into the game assets by game/tools/cleanup_provider_assets.py. The rights position is recorded in docs/ASSET_RIGHTS.md: redistribution is permitted by the provider terms, and the binaries are kept out of the git history only for repository size. No further Customuse credits may be spent without new owner authorisation (balance 53); Tripo balance is 75 450.
